# Service family catalog

Plugins publish versioned services for host-brokered discovery and typed invoke. Consumers never dial peer plugins directly.

Source of truth: Go catalogs under `apps/api` (`app/Support/Events`, `Capabilities`, `ExtensionManifest`, `Jobs`, and provider slot constants). Regenerate with:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate
```

Or verify CI drift:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate --check
```

## Callable transport boundary

Service discovery and invoke are host-brokered. before/after/wrap composition remains fail-closed until a host chain exists.

Callable transport exists (see wire RPCs).

## Accepted actions

- `add`, `before`, `after`, `wrap`, `replace`
- Current validation allows composition action tokens, but non-`add` actions still require a `targetId`. Unsupported host composition chains fail closed.

## Manifest declaration fields

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `id` / `contractVersion` | Versioned service identity; `contractVersion` is `id@positiveVersion` |
| `action` | Composition action (`add` for new providers) |
| `targetId` | Required when action is not `add` |
| `handler` | Backend operation entry |
| `requestSchema` / `responseSchema` | Versioned schema refs |
| `priority` | Host resolution order |

## Wire RPCs

| Direction | RPC | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host → plugin | `InvokeService` / `StreamService` | Dispatch to provider process |
| Plugin → host | `ServiceDiscoveryService.List` | Enumerate authorized services |
| Plugin → host | `ServiceDiscoveryService.Resolve` | Exact SemVer resolution |
| Plugin → host | `ServiceDiscoveryService.Invoke` | Unary brokered call |
| Plugin → host | `ServiceDiscoveryService.Stream` | Bidirectional brokered stream |

SDK: `pluginv2.ServiceRegistry` for providers; `Host.ListServices` / `ResolveService` / `InvokeService` for consumers. `ServiceDefinition.Version` must be strict SemVer, and its major must equal the Manifest service `contractVersion` `@N`; the Host rejects handshake drift.
